#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Source this file: source /data/mlr_ifa/activate.sh
export MLR_IFA_ROOT=/data/mlr_ifa
source /miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate "$MLR_IFA_ROOT/env"
export PYTHONPATH="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/config"
export HF_HOME="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/cache/huggingface"
export HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE="$HF_HOME/hub"
export TRANSFORMERS_CACHE="$HF_HOME/hub"
export TORCH_HOME="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/cache/torch"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/cache"
export PIP_CACHE_DIR="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/cache/pip"
export CONDA_PKGS_DIRS="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/cache/conda"
export TMPDIR="$MLR_IFA_ROOT/tmp"
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl
export MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0
export EGL_PLATFORM=surfaceless
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
export MPLBACKEND=Agg
cd "$MLR_IFA_ROOT/src"
